rows.42:0200:
"Hey!"
We all jumped out of our skins.
Since we'd been telling scary stories, a sudden visitor made our hearts skip a beat.
In the doorway stood a man, his eyebrows raised in anger.{p}
rows.42:0530:
"Honestly, staying this late..."
The teacher grumbled and complained, then clicked his tongue.
It looked like we were in for a tremendous scolding.
We lined up in a row outside the club room, hunching our heads down into our shoulders.
"That's enough for today.
We'll talk tomorrow. Now get yourselves home."
"Yes, sir!"
We practically fled for home.
The teacher followed us all the way to the school gate.
It wasn't to see us off, not at all. It was to make sure we really headed home.{p}
rows.42:09b4:
No wonder.
On the floor of the night-duty room lay a corpse he had killed just a little while ago, a kitchen knife still plunged into its back.
"Man, I wondered what I'd do if they found out.
On full-moon nights, I get this uncontrollable craving to kill people.
And here I'd finally found one nice piece of prey and gotten my fit to settle down.
...Well now. All that's left is figuring out how to dispose of this one."
The teacher stood at the kitchenette and began fixing a late supper.{p}All the while gazing at the corpse that should have been the seventh one, licking his lips hungrily...{p}
